description: Implementation of a thread pool wrapper for caffe2, managing thread creation, adjustment, and execution, including handling of process forking scenarios.

classes.name: PThreadPool
classes.description: A wrapper class managing a pthread-based thread pool, providing thread count management and task execution.

methods.name: PThreadPool::PThreadPool
methods.description: Constructor initializing the thread pool with a specified number of threads.

methods.name: PThreadPool::get_thread_count
methods.description: Returns the current number of threads in the pool.

methods.name: PThreadPool::set_thread_count
methods.description: Adjusts the thread count of the pool, reinitializing if necessary.

methods.name: PThreadPool::run
methods.description: Executes a function over a range of indices, either in parallel or sequentially based on guard state.
